title: Adverbs of Degree
intro:
Adverb of degree menjelaskan seberapa kuat sesuatu: very, quite, really, too, enough, extremely. Letaknya sebelum kata sifat atau adverb lain, kecuali enough yang diletakkan sesudahnya.
This coffee is very hot.
She runs really fast.
The room is big enough.

exercises.question: This coffee is ___ hot.
exercises.explanation: Very diletakkan sebelum kata sifat untuk menguatkannya: very hot.

exercises.question: She is not ___ to drive.
exercises.explanation: Enough diletakkan setelah kata sifat, berbeda dari very: old enough, bukan enough old.

exercises.question: The box is ___ heavy. I cannot lift it.
exercises.explanation: Too berarti terlalu, menandakan sesuatu yang berlebihan sampai jadi masalah.

exercises.prompt: Match each adverb to its meaning
exercises.explanation: Extremely paling kuat, quite lebih lemah, too berarti berlebihan, dan enough berarti cukup.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.explanation: Adverb of degree diletakkan sebelum kata sifat: really good.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.explanation: Adverb of degree juga bisa menguatkan adverb lain: very slowly.

exercises.sentence: This bag is not big ___ for my books.
exercises.explanation: Enough diletakkan setelah kata sifat: big enough.

exercises.question: Pick the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: Quite diletakkan sebelum kata sifat, dan setelah 'was' kita memakai kata sifat easy, bukan adverb easily.

exercises.task: Write one sentence about your city using an adverb of degree.
exercises.modelAnswer: Jakarta is very busy in the morning.
exercises.explanation: Gunakan very, quite, really, atau too sebelum kata sifat, misalnya 'Jakarta is very busy in the morning.'
